display.purpose: Hero H1 only. The single largest statement on the page.

title.purpose: Pillar and engagement-card sub-headlines, Inter not Newsreader.

body.purpose: Hero subhead and section intros, capped at 58-65ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrow labels and the engagement duration tag.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: translateY(16px) to translateY(0), opacity 0 to 1, 0.8s ease-out
motion.purpose: Hero H1 and subhead entrance on load.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease, translateY(16px) to none
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered reveal for section content below the hero.

components.name: Primary Button (Nav CTA)
components.description: Outlined ghost button, inverts to solid ink fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #2C2C2A; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(44,44,42,0.3); padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 2px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2C2C2A; color: #F9F8F5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1D9E75; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Pillar Icon
components.description: Monochrome line icon above a pillar headline, 1.5px stroke, no fill.
components.css: .ds-pillar-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; color: #1D9E75; margin-bottom: 32px; } .ds-pillar-icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1D9E75; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Muted-to-full-ink link used in the sticky top nav.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(44,44,42,0.65); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #2C2C2A; }

narrative.overview: Beigale Insights reads like the tabbed, precisely-assembled binder handed across the table at a deal's close: paper-white pages, one serif headline per section, everything else set in a quiet, structured sans. Nothing is decorative because nothing needs to persuade through decoration; the firm's confidence comes from the operators, not from the interface. The system is built for a reader who is mid-diligence, skimming fast, and judging seniority from restraint rather than volume. It explicitly rejects SaaS visual grammar: no gradient hero metrics, no filled icon sets, no card-grid sameness, no motion for its own sake. The only departure from flat paper-white is two deliberately scoped dark sections (Hero, About) that mark identity shifts, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-flat: no shadows, no elevation, depth comes from background contrast and whitespace only
One serif voice (Newsreader) reserved strictly for headlines; everything else is Inter
Two accent colors, each locked to a background: teal on light, gold on dark, never mixed
Generous, 8px-based rhythm; short lines everywhere, nothing reads as a text block

rules.name: The Background-Locks-the-Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal appears only on Warm Paper White sections; gold appears only on Boardroom Charcoal / Near-Black Oak sections. They never cross.

rules.name: The Sparse-Accent Rule
rules.body: Both accents are used for icons, eyebrow labels, links, and single-word emphasis. Neither is ever a background, a button fill, or a large shape.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Newsreader appears only at Display and Headline tier. Every other piece of type, including pillar and card headlines, is Inter.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system casts a shadow. Separation comes from whitespace, background contrast, and hairline 1px borders, never elevation.

dos: Do lock Ledger Teal to light sections and Signature Gold to dark sections, never crossed.
Do reserve Newsreader for Display and Headline tiers only.
Do cap paragraph copy at 58-65ch and keep every section scannable.
Do use the 8px-based spacing scale for all vertical rhythm.
Do keep dark backgrounds limited to Hero and About only.
donts: Don't use teal or gold as a background fill, button fill, or large shape.
Don't put Signature Gold on a light background; it is unreadable there.
Don't add shadows, gradients, gradient text, or glassmorphism.
Don't use decorative or filled icon sets.
Don't wrap pillars, engagements, or credibility points in card shells.
Don't add motion beyond the existing rise-in and scroll-reveal transitions.
